source_basis: we focused on components we felt were unconsidered ... while still making use of the most powerful tools
interpretation: Positions the paper against earlier work without claiming those papers were wrong. Keeps what worked.
counterevidence: The judgment of what was unconsidered is the authors' own.

source_basis: In other words, although we do not know the position of every player at every second
interpretation: An assumption followed by a plain restatement. The reader hears the objection before the defense.
counterevidence: None.

source_basis: we disagreed with the authors that motifs were the solution ... This should not be the case
interpretation: Names the paper, states the disagreement, and gives the counterexample in the same paragraph.
counterevidence: The counterexample is intuitive, not demonstrated.

source_basis: We are skeptical of the significance of this average, however
interpretation: Doubt attached to a metric the authors still compute. Keeps the number and warns about it.
applicability: Reusable hedge on a reported statistic.
counterevidence: The keeper's influence is asserted.

source_basis: Thus, additional analysis would not generate new information
interpretation: A candidate metric dropped with a reason, not silently.
counterevidence: Pace might still differ by style.

source_basis: We felt the study disregarded the many arbitrary factors
interpretation: Critique aimed at a specific omission, with examples: star players, tired goalkeepers, free kicks.
counterevidence: The examples are plausible, not measured.

source_basis: it is better to guess that one shot occurred than to predict anything
interpretation: A failed regression translated into the decision it implies. No softening.
counterevidence: None.

source_basis: we retain that coordination still holds a place ... but this model appears not to describe it
interpretation: Separates the belief from the failed operationalization.
counterevidence: The retained belief is then unsupported.

source_basis: This is particularly pleasing because metrics of our own design are competing with the literature
interpretation: Satisfaction stated openly and tied to a reason. Human papers admit pleasure at a result.
counterevidence: Pleasure is not evidence.

source_basis: Football is a noisy game, we're choosing to leave individual ability behind, and we have only 38 games
interpretation: Three reasons a modest fit should stand, given as a list rather than an apology.
applicability: Reusable defense of a moderate fit.
counterevidence: 38 games is still small.

source_basis: our team verbally debated each one
interpretation: Reports the process behind an arbitrary parameter: argument, not a formula.
applicability: Reusable when a parameter is a judgment.
counterevidence: Debate is not validation.

source_basis: We believe this resolves all remaining questions. No further research is needed. Just kidding!
interpretation: A mock closing sentence, retracted, with a web comic in the references. Breaks the template on purpose.
applicability: Reusable register break, once per paper at most.
counterevidence: Risky if the reader misses the retraction.

source_basis: Link, reciprocal link and triad defined from one pass count, position-aware
interpretation: Motifs rejected because position changes the meaning of a triad.
applicability: Weight structure by role, not just shape.
counterevidence: The position claim is not tested directly.

source_basis: Press time defined from the first opposing pass to the first duel or regain
interpretation: An original metric for the half of the game a passing network cannot see.
counterevidence: Unsuccessful attempts are included by choice.

source_basis: Shot count replaces goals; 7.2 percent of goals are set pieces
interpretation: Outcome variable defended with an external statistic.
applicability: Justify the dependent variable with a number.
counterevidence: The 7.2 percent is from a different league.

source_basis: Four styles placed by hand at integer standard deviations, then nearest centroid
interpretation: A classifier whose centroids are arguments rather than estimates.
counterevidence: Centroids dominate the result.

source_basis: R-squared 0.0298 leads to abandoning the dyad model, not to tweaking it
interpretation: A negative result changes the direction of the paper.
applicability: Let a failed model redirect the analysis.
counterevidence: A different strength definition might have saved it.

source_basis: Three decisions from one table: maximize win, maximize draw, minimize loss
interpretation: The same evidence supports different actions depending on what the coach needs.
counterevidence: The cells are sparse.

source_basis: R-squared 0.4668 and 51.3 percent within 1.5 shots
interpretation: Two summaries of one fit: variance explained and a practical tolerance.
applicability: Report a tolerance, not only a coefficient.
counterevidence: The tolerance of 1.5 was chosen.

source_basis: One more game moves a win rate by 11.9 percent
interpretation: Sensitivity expressed as the effect of a single future observation.
counterevidence: Only one matchup is worked out.

source_basis: Premier League set-piece rates stand in for the league in the data
interpretation: An external distribution borrowed, and the borrowing is declared.
counterevidence: The leagues may differ.

source_basis: Duels used as the event that marks a contest for possession
interpretation: A field most network papers ignore is made central.
applicability: Use the event types the file actually has.
counterevidence: Duels are not all possession contests.

source_basis: Actions on the ball are assumed sufficient, with the reason written out
interpretation: The assumption the whole model rests on is singled out as essential.
counterevidence: Off-ball positioning is invisible.

source_basis: Counter Attack folded into Long Ball because the metrics cannot tell them apart
interpretation: Two tactics merged for measurement reasons, not football reasons.
counterevidence: They may differ in ways the six metrics miss.

source_basis: Dyad model predicts worse than guessing one shot
interpretation: Baseline comparison stated in words.
applicability: Always compare with the obvious guess.
counterevidence: The baseline is informal.

source_basis: Tiki-Taka wins 58.1 percent and loses 9.7 percent
interpretation: A style ranked by both win rate and loss rate.
counterevidence: The sample per style is uneven.

source_basis: Coach told to play midfielder 3, train rondos, and consult a matchup table
interpretation: Findings converted into a named player, a drill, and a table.
counterevidence: The drill is borrowed from a citation, not tested.

source_basis: Three small network drawings: a link, a reciprocal link, a triad
interpretation: The three definitions drawn once each.
counterevidence: Positions are schematic.

source_basis: Regression ranking used as the selection figure
interpretation: Variable selection shown as a ranked list rather than described.
applicability: Show the ranking that justifies a cut.
counterevidence: The figure is a summary, not the full output.

source_basis: A figure whose only job is to show the classification changes when the scaling changes
interpretation: Sensitivity given its own picture.
counterevidence: Only one alternative scaling is drawn.

source_basis: A full letter addressed to the coach, signed by the team
interpretation: The advice section is written to its actual reader, in the second person.
applicability: Reusable for the required letter deliverable.
counterevidence: The tone is informal.

source_basis: An xkcd strip cited as reference 10
interpretation: The joke in the text is backed by a real citation, so it reads as intended.
applicability: If you break register, cite it.
counterevidence: Some judges will not recognize it.
